intro.lead: I build Android interfaces that stay fast and reliable at the scale of **4M orders a day** — cart, payments, rendering and the design system underneath them.
intro.leadSub: Senior engineer at Blinkit (Eternal), where I own cart and payment surfaces, established the Jetpack Compose foundation, and build server-driven UI, observability and release-safety systems used across product teams. I lead a four-engineer Android team and have mentored engineers to promotion.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer 2
jobs.titleline: Cart, payments, rendering, design system & SDUI
bullets: Owned the cart surface: **lifted conversion 4%** (**10% for new users**) and drove **2% recovery** through Save for Later.

Established the **Jetpack Compose foundation** and standardized **20+ reusable design-system components** adopted across product teams — Compose now powers 20% of screens, with new surfaces defaulting to it.
Sped up app launch, **cutting cold-start 12%** and **first-screen render 20%** by initializing critical components earlier.
**Cut initial load & bind time 3×** on a heavy scrollable screen with a virtualized grid that binds in chunks — later reused across Wishlist and other long lists.
Instrumented **per-screen scroll metrics** now used by other teams, feeding Grafana dashboards and release gates.
Authored incident post-mortems, gated launches with LaunchDarkly, and led sprint planning, code reviews and release delivery for the Android team.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer 1
bullets: Re-architected payments to standardize checkout handoff, payment-state handling and gateway integration.
Built a checkout flow that **surfaces applicable payment instruments early**, cutting offer/payment mismatches **20%**.
Integrated Juspay offers, the Simpl SDK (**6% of direct transactions** via OTP-free checkout) and UPI Collect.
Built a reusable **cart messaging framework** for interactive offers, discounts and warnings — extended to discovery screens, **contributing 7% of offer impressions**.

jobs.title: System Engineer
bullets: **Cut page-load time by 2s** on a freelancer hiring platform by restructuring API calls and caching responses.
Built survey-validation middleware and rebuilt the scoring engine, **reducing result computation by 400ms**.
**Cut React form-development time 60%** with a reusable validation & submission hook.

jobs.title: Side projects & early roles
bullets: Built **Provin**, a React Native service-request tracker that cut manual tracking **90%**.
Shipped discussion-thread support for **VOZ**; built Python invoice automation at an e-commerce startup.

paragraphs: I'm an Android engineer who likes building the foundations other engineers build on — rendering, state, design systems and server-driven UI — and then making them measurably fast and safe to ship.

At Blinkit I work where the stakes are highest: cart and payments, the surfaces between a customer deciding and a customer paying. The work spans Compose adoption, virtualized rendering, performance instrumentation, and release gating with real dashboards and post-mortems behind it.
I lead a four-engineer Android team, run sprint planning and reviews, and have mentored engineers to promotion. Outside the day job I write Kotlin, Go and TypeScript, and tinker with side projects.
